subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers + action-form — the chat↔dashboard loop

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this bundled dashboard and prompt-dispatch architecture after repair, or require the initiative to be split or redesigned before landing?
rationale: The branch establishes a new default product surface, persistent state owner, unauthenticated browser route, and agent-dispatch capability; automation cannot authorize those product and security boundaries.

options.title: Sponsor after architectural repair
options.body: Confirm the direction and require SQLite persistence, all six finding fixes, dependency and security approval, clean stacking, and direct proof before merge.

options.title: Require narrower replacement PRs
options.body: Keep the roadmap but replace this cumulative branch with isolated storage, UI, sandbox, and action-form PRs.

options.title: Pause the dashboard initiative
options.body: Stop the implementation series until a later product cycle.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after architectural repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the direction and require SQLite persistence, all six finding fixes, dependency and security approval, clean stacking, and direct proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the closest current-main product and architectural precedent and is already following this PR.
